title: Looking for 5 Polymarket traders to beta test something we're building
author: Interesting_Ear_2124
selftext:
Hey guys, we've been working on something new for Polymarket traders, and we're looking for 5 people to try it before we share it publicly.

Ideally, you're actively trading on Polymarket and interested in learning how other traders approach the market.

We're offering a $30 gift card in exchange for your time and honest feedback.

if you're interested, leave a comment or DM me.
